apps.name: Open WebUI + Ollama
apps.tagline: Chat with local AI models, privately
apps.description: A ChatGPT-style interface for open models running on your own hardware. Ollama downloads and runs the models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, …); Open WebUI gives you chats, documents, web search and multiple users.
apps.first_run: The first account you create becomes the admin. Download a model under Settings → Models (e.g. llama3.2).

releases.notes: Added to the NoCapOS App Store. Ollama runs beside Open WebUI on a private network.

apps.name: Vaultwarden
apps.description: A lightweight Bitwarden server. Use the official Bitwarden apps and browser extensions with your passwords stored on your own hardware.
apps.first_run: The web vault needs HTTPS to log in from other devices (browsers block its encryption on plain HTTP). It works right away from this computer via localhost; for other devices put it behind HTTPS (Tailscale is coming to NoCapOS).

releases.notes: Added to the NoCapOS App Store.
